name: Music and Linguistics
notes: Six courses. Offered through the Music and Sound Initiative; satisfies the social sciences division of the Rochester Curriculum.
DEPARTMENT-CODE TRANSLATION: the Music and Sound Initiative page writes 'BCS', 'LIN' and 'MUR' where the registrar's catalog uses BCSC, LING and MUSC. All codes here are translated.
No more than two courses may overlap with the student's major or another minor.
Eastman School music theory courses are acceptable in place of MUSC 111 or MUSC 112.

requirementGroups.label: Required courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Music and Linguistics Minor ... All four of the following: BCS 260: Music and the Mind; LIN 110: Introduction to Linguistic Analysis; MUR 111: Theory I; MUR 112: Theory II

requirementGroups.label: Two linguistics electives
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus two of the following: LIN 210: Introduction to Language Sound Systems; LIN 220: Introduction to Grammatical Systems; LIN 225: Introduction to Semantic Analysis; LIN 227: Topics in Phonetics and Phonology
